title.value: AWQ: Activation-aware Weight Quantization for On-Device LLM Compression and Acceleration

ev.quote: AWQ: ACTIVATION-AWARE WEIGHT QUANTIZATION FOR ON-DEVICE LLM COMPRESSION AND ACCELERATION
Proceedings of the 7th MLSys Conference, Santa Clara, CA, USA, 2024. Best Paper Award.

contribution.value: AWQ is a hardware-friendly low-bit weight-only PTQ method that protects the top 1% salient channels using activation-aware per-channel scaling, with no backpropagation, and is paired with TinyChat to deliver 3-4x edge speedup over FP16.

ev.quote: We propose Activation-aware Weight Quantization (AWQ), a hardware-friendly approach for LLM low-bit weight-only quantization. AWO finds that not all weights in an LLM are equally important. Protecting only 1% salient weights can greatly reduce quantization error.

strengths.value: Hardware-friendly: avoids mixed-precision by using per-channel scaling, so 4-bit weights stay in a uniform integer format.

ev.quote: To avoid the hardware-inefficient mix-precision quantization, we mathematically derive that scaling up the salient channels can reduce the quantization error.

strengths.value: Generalist: no backpropagation or reconstruction, so it does not overfit calibration data and works for instruction-tuned and multi-modal LLMs.

ev.quote: AWQ does not rely on any backpropagation or reconstruction, so it generalizes to different domains and modalities without overfitting the calibration set.

strengths.value: Data-efficient: needs roughly 10x less calibration data than GPTQ (16 vs 192 sequences) for OPT-6.7B INT3.

ev.quote: it can achieve better perplexity using 10x smaller calibration set compared to GPTQ (16 sequences v.s. 192 sequences).

strengths.value: Practical edge speedup: TinyChat delivers 3-4x measured speedup on desktop, laptop, and mobile GPUs, including Llama-2-70B on a single Jetson Orin.

ev.quote: TinyChat further translates the ~4x lower memory footprint to measured speedup. On desktop, laptop and mobile GPUs, we consistently observe a 3.2-3.3x average speedup

weaknesses.value: Does not quantize activations - W4A16 keeps activations in FP16 and only reduces weight memory.
